name: zz-access
description: Access, yours and everybody's: your platform token, your keys for the building blocks, and the setup for whichever client you work in — plus, if your role carries them, the people, teams, flow installs and block grants behind them. One door; the tools you are offered are the ones your role can execute.
purpose: To be the one door for every credential, every question about who may do what, and the operator acts that keep a deployment usable — your platform token, your block keys, your client setup, and, if your role carries them, the people, teams, installs and grants behind them, plus the repairs only somebody responsible for the whole deployment can make. A tool belongs here when it hands somebody a key, changes who holds one, or is an operator's act on a deployment rather than a step inside one team's work.
